clauses.quote: All Related Service Providers, covered under this section, shall perform duties related to their special field, except as otherwise provided in this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: All Related Service Providers, covered under this section

clauses.quote: DCPS Related Service Provider standards shall consider the standards of the American Speech and Hearing Association, the National Association of Social Workers, and the National Association of School Psychologists.
clauses.notes: Grammatical subject is 'standards', but functionally an administrative directive setting criteria.

clauses.quote: Related Service Providers shall not be assigned duties or perform acts which would result in a violation of standards of professional practice as defined by the appropriate professional organizations.

A room conducive to individual testing, interviewing, and the transaction of business of a confidential nature shall be made available to school psychologists, school social workers and other Related Service Providers as needed.
clauses.subject_text: A room conducive to individual testing, interviewing, and the transaction of business of a confidential nature

clauses.quote: Where a speech suite, a converted area or a room that is specifically designated for Speech language therapy and Hearing therapy services exists, the Speech language therapist and/or Hearing therapist will be assigned to that designated space on the day or days that the employee is in that building.
clauses.subject_text: the Speech language therapist and/or Hearing therapist
clauses.notes: Implicit agent is management; grammatical subject is the worker.

clauses.quote: A Related Service Provider who is required to appear at a placement meeting, an assessment, a disciplinary hearing or a due process hearing shall have the opportunity to consult with the designated representatives of DCPS in advance of the event.
clauses.subject_text: A Related Service Provider who is required to appear at a placement meeting, an assessment, a disciplinary hearing or a due process hearing

clauses.quote: Related service providers may express in writing to the principal/Supervisor their preference for program assignments as long as the request is consistent with the educational needs of the system.
If the related service provider does not receive his/her requested assignment, he/she shall be so notified in writing with the reason(s) stated.
clauses.notes: Implicit agent is management; grammatical subject is the worker.

clauses.quote: Protocols for all related service providers shall be provided by the DCPS Office of Special Education.
clauses.subject_text: Protocols for all related service providers
